content.title: FCX, Alcoa Rise As Copper, Aluminum Prices Heat Up
content.summary: Freeport-McMoRan cleared third-quarter earnings estimates early Thursday but offered no timeline for restarting production after its Grasberg mine disaster.  FCX stock rose, as the near-term copper contract rose toward the top of its recent trading range.  Meanwhile, Alcoa jumped amid a surge in aluminum prices after posting slightly better-than-forecast results late Wednesday.
